reasoning: The claim that humans only use 10% of their brain capacity is a widely debunked neurological myth. Modern neuroscience, supported by brain imaging technologies like fMRI and PET scans, demonstrates that virtually all areas of the brain show activity throughout the day, even during sleep. Brain damage to almost any area causes functional deficits, and inactive brain tissue naturally atrophies or degrades, further disproving the idea that 90% of the brain lies dormant and untapped.
